credits.title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
credits.overview: Follows Lisa, a successful designer returning for a school reunion, exploring themes of identity, family acceptance, romance with a rugby player, and personal growth within a Tongan-New Zealand community.

credits.title: Parallax Of The Liminal Void
credits.overview: Spiraling into the abyss, two melancholic yet hopelessly infatuated lovers are imprisoned in a beetle-infested nightmare. Wallowing in sorrow, they attempt to maintain a grip on reality to escape torment. The void beckons, death answers.

credits.title: Gun Powder
credits.overview: It's 1999 on the hottest day of the year, and an ensemble of teens are engaged in a turf war over their local skate park.  However, a circulating mysterious drug threatens to cut their lives viciously short.

credits.title: The Exchange
credits.overview: Sabina and Esther's relationship is pushed to breaking point when international exchange student Annie comes to stay.
